title: Recital 14: examples of extraordinary circumstances
excerpt: (14) As under the Montreal Convention, obligations on operating air carriers should be limited or excluded in cases where an event has been caused by extraordinary circumstances which could not have been avoided even if all reasonable measures had been taken. Such circumstances may, in particular, occur in cases of political instability, meteorological conditions incompatible with the operation of the flight concerned, security risks, unexpected flight safety shortcomings and strikes that affect the operation of an operating air carrier.
summary: Extraordinary circumstances may include political instability, weather incompatible with the flight, security risks, unexpected flight safety shortcomings and strikes.
